answer: Each epoch every identity stakes 25.000 POA in a peer-prediction market on whether a randomly assigned peer is genuine; bets settle against the jury verdict: a wrong bet forfeits the stake, half burned, half to correct predictors; a convicted fake is banned 12 epochs. Stakes form a basalt base beneath shale: one operator with 1.000 fakes must risk 25.000.000 POA defending them; one conviction sends a ripple through the farm and every stake falls at once, while an honest agent risks one 25.000 stake. Limitation: an honest agent who misreads a subtle case still loses its stake.
